review_intro: Everything waiting for a decision, oldest first. We promise applicants a decision within {days} days.
review_reject_body: The reason applies to applications and opportunities. Owners get an email with the reason and your note, except for spam.
review_unsupported: {count} items are handled in their own area and were not changed.
review_gone: {count} items were already decided by someone else.
review_failed: {count} items could not be decided. Check the reason and note, then try again.
review_owner_has_listing: {count} applications use an address whose account already owns a listing or is blocked. Reject them, or move the existing listing first.
review_error: The decision failed. Please try again.
review_report_body: Tell us what is wrong. An administrator reads every report. Nothing is hidden automatically, and we do not tell the listing who reported it.
review_report_sent: Thank you. We received your report.
review_report_error_captcha: The security check did not pass. Wait a moment and send again.
review_report_error_wait: The security check is still running. Wait a moment and send again.
review_report_error_limit: You already reported this or sent too many reports. Try again later.
review_report_error: The report could not be sent. Please try again.
review_changes_intro: Every change to listings and other records, newest first. Reverting restores the listing fields only, never tags or connections.
review_changes_dialog_body: Before is what the field held. Now is what it holds today. Reverting writes the before value back.
review_changes_not_restorable: Not restorable: the old value was removed after 90 days or never stored.
review_changes_not_revertible: This change cannot be reverted. Only unreverted edits of listing fields with stored old values can.
review_changes_reverted_done: Change reverted. The owner is told by email.
review_changes_revert_failed: The change could not be reverted. Reload and try again.
review_remove_body: The post is taken down and its owner gets an email with the reason and your note, even for spam.
review_expired: {count} posts could not be approved because their deadline has passed. Reject them with a reason instead.
review_no_account: {count} posts were handled, but their entries have no account, so no email was sent. Tell the owners yourself.
